mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 60% of GDPC1 rising periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 7.0% triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as strengthening labor market confidence boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20% of instances where UNRATE <7% but returns not positive, or p-value > 0.05 in t-tests.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and GDP (GDPC1) signals expansionary monetary policy, amplifying equity valuations over 60 days through lower discount rates.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window, or positive returns not observed in 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion with rising demand (GDPC1) and labor (UNRATE), 20-day S&P 500 returns are positive as markets anticipate peak growth and price appreciation.
regime_hint: late-cycle expansion with rising demand and labor
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive in >60% of regime periods, or IC < 0.03 over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly rise in INDPRO (supply index) indicates robust manufacturing activity, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through expanded production capacity.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 70% of INDPRO rising periods, or IC < 0.03 over 4-year window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO crossing above 100 signals strong sector growth, prompting positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate sustained production momentum.
failure_condition: 20% of instances where INDPRO >100 but returns not positive, or p > 0.05 in t-tests.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) alongside INDPRO (supply) suggests controlled inflation and robust demand, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through market optimism.
failure_condition: IC < 0.03 over 3-year window, or positive returns not observed in 75% of interactions.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising) with improving labor market (UNRATE falling), 20-day S&P 500 returns are positive as investors anticipate lower future rates.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with improving labor market
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive in >50% of regime periods, or IC < 0.03 over 5-year window.
